examples.text: At that time, the goddess was overseeing another sacred quest, pursued by a righteous monk named Tripitaka. He had set out to retrieve scriptures from the West, but the path was too long and dangerous to travel alone. So Guanyin promised to arrange Sun Wukong’s freedom

source.text: The tale of the Monkey King and the Buddha - Ji Hao

relations.reason: reclaim 和 retrieve 都可涉及“取回/重新获得”某物，但 retrieve 更偏“找回、取回、带回”，例句中是 retrieve scriptures；reclaim 更强调恢复原本拥有的权利、土地或控制权，适合作为易混相关词互相跳转。
